basic_profile.bio: I'm a 26-year-old graphic designer based in Austin, Texas, who recently discovered a passion for interior design. I'm still learning the ropes but love experimenting with colors and textures. I spend most of my online hours in the evenings after work, usually between 7 PM and midnight. During the day, I work at a local design agency. I'm single and enjoy spending my weekends exploring local art galleries and hiking trails.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in graphic design and have been working in the field for about four years. My interest in interior design is recent, sparked by a project I worked on that involved creating digital mockups for a client's home renovation. I've been teaching myself through online courses and forums.
